rows.en:
…!?

[HERO2], [HERO4]! What are you two doing here?
Are you searching for the Science Patrol member too, Goro?
What!? The Neo-Human Empire?
…!? Who are you?
Toge Banbaraaa!! You're Goro Watari, are you? I've been waiting for you to be alone!
So we're not even on his radar…
I'm sorry. It's because my functions are impaired…

…!?

No… That's not what this is about, is it, [HERO4]?

Alone?

Hey… what about us?
Looks like… we don't even count as fighters to him.
Even his jokes are thorny… this guy.

Fufufu…

Hmph!
Whoa!
Fufufu… How's that, Goro Watari? My thorns are filled with deadly poison.
What!? Ugh…
Hahaha… What's wrong, Goro Watari?
Damn it…
Goriki Shorai!!

Kukuku… Well? With the poison spreading, you can't transform, can you?

You'll die right here! Get him!!
"Hey, who's there?"
"Who on earth are you?"
"An alien… from the M… 78… Nebula…"
"An alien from the M78 Nebula?"

"Yes…

From far-off space… I was carrying Bemular to the cosmic graveyard when it escaped from me, and I chased it to Earth…"
"Bemular?"

"A devil of a kaiju… that disturbs the peace of the universe…

I have wronged you… Hayata… In return… I will give you my life."
"Your life? What will happen to you?"
"I will become one with you… body and soul… And then… I want to work for the peace of Earth… I will… entrust this to you."
"What is this?"
"The Beta Capsule…"
"The Beta Capsule?"
"When you are in trouble, use this! Then…"
"Then what happens?"
"Fwah-fwah-fwah-fwah… There is… nothing… to worry about…"
Yes, this is Science Patrol HQ.
How are you doing, Fuji?
Hayata!? Where on earth are you? Everyone's out looking for you!

Never mind that.

More importantly, I need you to bring Submarine S16 to the Y-marked point at Ryugamori…
The Y-marked point! Got it…

Goro!

Damn it… Toge Banbara's poison has spread through his whole body, hasn't it?

Goro!

Oh no… Toge Banbara's poison has spread through his whole body, hasn't it?

Goro!

Damn… Toge Banbara's poison has spread through his whole body.

Goro!

This might be bad… Looks like Toge Banbara's poison has spread all through him?
Uwaaaagh…
Hey!! You lot!! Where did you run off to, leaving the shop unattended?

…!?

Goro! What's wrong? What on earth happened?
So… how is he? How's Goro doing?

He is in an extremely dangerous condition…

If we knew Toge Banbara's biological structure, I could produce the appropriate antibodies…

We've sent part of the thorn we recovered to the TDF science group…

But it probably won't make it in time.
Then what about Goro?
How about trying a poisonous herb?
A poisonous herb?
Yes… Depending on how it's used, a poisonous herb can become medicine…
But… if we get it wrong, Goro's life…

Let's try it!

If we just leave him be, Goro won't make it! We have to bet on that slim chance.

I can't say for sure…

For now, [HERO4]'s healing ability has done everything it can…
But I'm not confident… I don't even know Toge Banbara's biological structure.
Now all we can do is rely on Goro's own power to recover…
Aw, come on… this is Goro we're talking about! A little rest and he'll be right as rain, right?
…I hope so.
This is Muramatsu… I don't recall requesting a submarine launch.
Oh, Cap… I got word from Hayata and brought it out here.
Hayata!?
Fuji… you must've been hallucinating!
No… It was really, truly Hayata. …Detaching S16.
But… what's the point of leaving S16 in a place like that?
Hayata contacted me and told me to leave it at the Y-marked point.
Cap! Don't you think the shock's got her dreaming?
No way!?
No, maybe, just maybe… Women are harder creatures to figure out than kaiju, after all.
So… that Hayata guy still hasn't been found?
No… I contacted Science Patrol HQ, but only a boy named Hoshino was there.
Which means… they're still searching!

…!?

Enemies detected! Five Phantom Soldiers!!
Oh, looks like you're finally back in shape, [HERO4]!
So… that Hayata guy really still hasn't been found?
Yeah… I called Science Patrol HQ, but there was only a boy named Hoshino there.
Hmm… So they're still searching, huh?
Whoa, more of them! This is never going to end.

uncertain: U03300: pun on トゲ (thorns) kept as 'thorny'.
U03307: 剛力招来 kept as the show's call 'Goriki Shorai!!'.
U03309-U03324: whole lines in 『』 (Hayata's exchange with the alien in a mental space) rendered in double quotes.
U03312: speaker is 謎の声 (Mysterious Voice), Ultraman before being named; 'alien' kept gender-neutral.
U03354: 晴霍 read as 幻覚 (hallucination).
U03360: Ide's sexist joke kept at full strength.

new_names.why: Sanagiman transformation call, not in glossary
